tables.title: O utput control bits for complementary tim_ocx and tim_ocxn channels with break
tables.text_helper: Table 362, "O utput control bits for complementary tim_ocx and tim_ocxn channels with break", in section 35.8.9 (TIM capture/compare enable register (TIM_CCER)) on page 1431. Columns: Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Output states(1), Output states(1). 13 data row(s). Notes: 1. When both outputs of a channel are not used (control taken over by GPIO controller), the OISx, OISxN, CCxP and CCxNP bits must be kept cleared.
